title: How a Godly Man Goes First, Even When He's Right
caption:
Christ didn't wait until we deserved it. He went first, to the cross, for people who were the ones actually wrong.

Being right feels like a reason to wait for the other guy to move. It isn't. Own the twenty percent that was yours and say it out loud.

Who's waiting on you to go first this week?

#faith #leadership #humility #christianmen #manofgod
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
